title: RideChain: Decentralized Carpooling for a Sustainable Future on Cardano

• Trip creation flows

3. Peer review reports on how smart contracts meet the project’s technical and security requirements.

ms.promise:
Timeline: Month 4-6
Outputs:
 1. Develop the Minimum Viable Product (MVP), integrating:
 • Smart contracts for trip bookings, payment escrows, and trip completion.
 • Decentralized Identity (DID) for secure user authentication.
 • A blockchain-based reputation system to capture and display user feedback.
 2. Build web and mobile dApp user interfaces (UIs) to provide accessibility for all users, incorporating:
 • Trip creation and scheduling for drivers.
 • Browsing and booking trips for passengers.
 • Payment functionality using tADA for testing.
 3. Conduct internal testing of the MVP to evaluate functionality, usability, and system integration across both web and mobile platforms.
ms.criteria:
1. A publicly accessible MVP deployed on the Cardano testnet, allowing:
 • Drivers to create trips and manage schedules through web and mobile dApps.
 • Passengers to browse, book trips, and make payments using tADA on both platforms.
 • Users to provide feedback, contributing to a blockchain-based reputation system.
 2. Successful internal testing results demonstrating the MVP’s functionality across web and mobile interfaces, ensuring a seamless user experience.

ms.promise:
1. Launch the MVP in a controlled pilot program using ADA for transactions, targeting a select community (e.g., a university or city in Ghana).
2. Recruit at least 100 participants (drivers and passengers) to use the platform actively during the pilot phase.
3. Collect user feedback on:
· Platform usability across web and mobile dApps.
· Payment system reliability and ease of use.
· Reputation system functionality.
Assess system performance under real-world usage conditions, including transaction success rates, platform reliability, and user engagement metrics.
ms.criteria:
1. At least 200 trips are booked and completed during the pilot phase using ADA.
2. The launch event is successfully conducted with images and videos captured to showcase participant involvement and platform demonstration.
3. Feedback is collected from at least 75% of participants, providing insights on:
· Usability
· Payment processing
· Reputation system
· Overall experience.
4. Performance benchmarks are met, including transaction success rates of 95% or higher, average booking times under 5 minutes, and minimal downtime (<1%).
